status: PRIOR — descriptive record of realised reactions, NOT a predictor. Announcement dates are volume-detected heuristics, not official filings. Thin sample per name. Walk-forward test before gating anything on it.

method.announcement_detection: highest-volume session per reporting window, requiring volume >= 1.8x the trailing 20-day median. Selected on VOLUME ONLY so the measured return is not chosen on its own magnitude.
method.reaction: close-to-close 1-day and 3-day from the prior close. Relative is measured twice: vs NIFTY, and vs the stock's own sector index where one exists (the sharper benchmark — it strips the sector move and leaves the stock-specific surprise).
method.corporate_actions: clean gaps matching a standard bonus/split ratio are back-adjusted IN MEMORY ONLY; the database is not modified

corporate_actions_found.likely_action: demerger — PV+JLR (TMPV) retained, TMLCV spun off 1:1; market split ~61/39
